program.name: Pilates Glute 35
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: Pilates for the glutes and legs one day, abs and sides the next.
program.about: Pilates with the glutes in front. One day is bridges, pelvic curls, clams, side kicks and kneeling kicks with standing leg work; the other is the abdominal series and side work. They alternate. Both later levels add reps.
